set-variable.name: contentSafetyMode
set-variable.value: @{ var raw = "{{content-safety-mode}}"; var mode = String.IsNullOrEmpty(raw) ? "" : raw.Trim().ToLowerInvariant(); return mode == "off" ? "off" : (mode == "audit" ? "audit" : "block"); }

set-variable.name: contentSafetyThreshold
set-variable.value: @{ var parsed = 2; if (!int.TryParse("{{content-safety-threshold}}", out parsed)) { parsed = 2; } if (parsed < 0) { parsed = 0; } if (parsed > 6) { parsed = 6; } return parsed; }

set-variable.name: contentSafetySlice
contentSafetyDecisionJson
set-variable.value: @{ return new JObject(new JProperty("decision", "unscreenable"), new JProperty("blockedBy", "unscreenable"), new JProperty("hateSeverity", 0), new JProperty("violenceSeverity", 0), new JProperty("selfHarmSeverity", 0), new JProperty("sexualSeverity", 0), new JProperty("promptShieldUserAttackDetected", false), new JProperty("promptShieldDocumentAttackDetected", false), new JProperty("contentSafetyStatusCode", 0), new JProperty("contentSafetyErrorClass", "invalid_request")).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None); }

set-variable.name: contentSafetyDecisionJson
set-variable.value: @{ return new JObject(new JProperty("decision", "pass"), new JProperty("blockedBy", "none"), new JProperty("hateSeverity", 0), new JProperty("violenceSeverity", 0), new JProperty("selfHarmSeverity", 0), new JProperty("sexualSeverity", 0), new JProperty("promptShieldUserAttackDetected", false), new JProperty("promptShieldDocumentAttackDetected", false), new JProperty("contentSafetyStatusCode", 0), new JProperty("contentSafetyErrorClass", "none")).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None); }

set-variable.name: contentSafetyShieldNeeded
set-variable.value: @{ var s = JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["contentSafetySlice"]); var d = s["documents"] as JArray; return !String.IsNullOrEmpty((string)s["userPrompt"]) || (d != null && d.Count > 0); }

send-request.set-body: @{ var s = JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["contentSafetySlice"]); return new JObject(new JProperty("userPrompt", (string)s["userPrompt"]), new JProperty("documents", (JArray)s["documents"])).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None); }

@{ var s = JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["contentSafetySlice"]); return new JObject(new JProperty("text", (string)s["analyzeText"]), new JProperty("categories", new JArray("Hate", "Violence", "SelfHarm", "Sexual")), new JProperty("outputType", "FourSeverityLevels")).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None); }

set-variable.name: contentSafetyDecisionJson

return-response.set-body: {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"The request body could not be read for content screening"}}
